title: 🖱️ User Activity
description: Track user interactions — team selections, filter changes, searches, and navigation patterns across the application.

queries.sql: select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action'
select count(distinct action) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action'
select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' and action='filter_change'
select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' and action like 'select_%'
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, action, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' group by zo_sql_key, action order by zo_sql_key
select action, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' group by action order by zo_sql_num desc
select team, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' and action='select_team' and team is not null group by team order by zo_sql_num desc
select team1, team2, count(*) as searches from "web_events" where team1 is not null and team2 is not null group by team1, team2 order by searches desc
select filter_key, filter_value, count(*) as used from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' and action='filter_change' group by filter_key, filter_value order by used desc
select _timestamp, action, page, team, filter_key, filter_value from "web_events" where event_type='user_action' order by _timestamp desc limit 25
